name: Startup Folders
purpose: Any shortcut or executable placed here launches automatically at user logon.
normal_baseline: Contains only shortcuts placed by legitimate software installers.
anomalies: Unrecognized script or executable dropped directly into the folder
LNK target pointing to a scripting interpreter with suspicious arguments
anti_forensic_notes: Trivially removed by deleting the file; file-system timestamps on the item itself (not just its LNK target) can help date when persistence was planted.
